title: Circulator
text: Model ideal frequency-independent circulators with S-parameters, {Select component} sets Circulator direction Circulator; {Reference impedances (Ohm)} sets the reference impedance of circulator, {Phase shift, ports 1 and 2 (rad)} sets the angle to shift phase of signal in port, {Phase shift, ports 3 (rad)} sets the angle to shift phase of signal in port and {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Select component
params.values: Circulator direction Circulator clockwise (default) | Circulator counter clockwise | Tee H-plane (S11=0) | Reciprocal phase shifter

params.name: Reference impedances (Ohm)
params.values: Reference impedance of circulator 50 (default) | positive scalar | three-tuple vector

params.name: Phase shift, ports 1 and 2 (rad)
params.values: Angle to shift phase of signal in port 1 and port 2 0 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Phase shift, ports 3 (rad)
params.values: Angle to shift phase of signal in port 3 0 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: Ground RF circuit terminals on (default) | off
